title: Description issues instructions to the model
detail: Description of "request_project_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates and immediately sends an external project inquiry to a private Relux Works Telegram chat for human review. Do not call it to test the connector or demon…

remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

remediation.title: Description uses pressure/override language
remediation.detail: Description of "request_project_quote" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "request_project_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
